verifications.claim: As of March 18, 2026, Micheál Martin is the Taoiseach of Ireland.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Minister responsible Micheál Martin, Taoiseach'; R3: 'Micheál Martin 23 January 2025 Incumbent'; R8: 'Taoiseach Incumbent Assumed office 23 January 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Martin as current Taoiseach as of 2026 context.

verifications.claim: Micheál Martin took office on January 23, 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Micheál Martin 23 January 2025 Incumbent'; R8: 'Assumed office 23 January 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Exact date matches current term start.

verifications.claim: Micheál Martin serves as the head of government.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the title in Ireland for the head of government'; R3: 'The Taoiseach ... is the head of government of Ireland'; R4: 'Ireland's head of government'
verifications.reasoning: Taoiseach defined as head of government; Martin is Taoiseach.

verifications.claim: Micheál Martin leads the cabinet.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The civil servant who heads the Department of the Taoiseach ... serves as the cabinet secretary'; R4: 'the taoiseach ... and ministers altogether comprise the Government, Ireland's central executive authority'

verifications.claim: Micheál Martin appoints government members.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: 'All other ministers are appointed upon the advice of the taoiseach'
verifications.reasoning: Taoiseach advises/nominates appointments by President; claim simplifies to 'appoints'.

verifications.claim: Micheál Martin maintains majority support in the Dáil Éireann.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Micheál Martin 23 January 2025 Incumbent 34th Dáil'
verifications.reasoning: Incumbent implies support, but no explicit statement on current majority.

verifications.claim: The Taoiseach is the leader of Ireland's central executive authority.
verifications.label: CLEAR
